helpers:
Private Function RaisesHandledEnd() As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Raise 1004
    RaisesHandledEnd = "inside " & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function RaisesHandledExit() As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Raise 1004
    RaisesHandledExit = "inside " & Err.Number
    Exit Function
End Function

Private Sub RaisesHandledSub()
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Raise 1004
End Sub

Private Function SetsWithoutHandler() As String
    Err.Number = 5
    SetsWithoutHandler = "inside " & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function Plain() As String
    Plain = "inside " & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function PlainExit() As String
    PlainExit = "inside " & Err.Number
    Exit Function
End Function

Private Function Clears() As String
    Err.Clear
    Clears = "inside " & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function RaisesUnhandled() As String
    Err.Raise 1004
End Function

Private Function HandlerLabel() As String
    On Error GoTo Bad
    Err.Raise 13
    HandlerLabel = "not here"
    Exit Function
Bad:
    HandlerLabel = "handled " & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function HandlerResume() As String
    Dim seen As Long
    On Error GoTo Bad
    Err.Raise 13
    HandlerResume = "resumed " & seen & " " & Err.Number
    Exit Function
Bad:
    seen = Err.Number
    Resume Next
End Function

Private Function ErrorStatementHandled() As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Error 11
    ErrorStatementHandled = "inside " & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function HandlerExit() As String
    On Error GoTo Bad
    Err.Raise 13
    Exit Function
Bad:
    HandlerExit = "handled " & Err.Number
    Exit Function
End Function

Private Sub PlainSub()
    Dim x As Long
    x = 1
End Sub

Private Function Outer() As String
    Outer = "outer sees " & Err.Number & ", " & Plain()
End Function

cases.name: handled_end
cases.body: out = RaisesHandledEnd() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: handled_exit
cases.body: out = RaisesHandledExit() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: handled_sub
cases.body:
RaisesHandledSub
out = "after " & Err.Number

cases.name: set_without_handler
cases.body: out = SetsWithoutHandler() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: caller_error_through_plain_call
cases.body:
On Error Resume Next
Err.Raise 7
out = "before " & Err.Number & " / " & Plain() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: caller_error_through_plain_exit
cases.body:
On Error Resume Next
Err.Raise 7
out = "before " & Err.Number & " / " & PlainExit() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: caller_error_through_handled_call
cases.body:
On Error Resume Next
Err.Raise 7
out = "before " & Err.Number & " / " & RaisesHandledEnd() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: callee_clears
cases.body:
On Error Resume Next
Err.Raise 7
out = Clears() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: unhandled_reaches_caller
cases.body:
On Error Resume Next
out = "skipped"
out = RaisesUnhandled()
out = out & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: on_error_again
cases.body:
On Error Resume Next
Err.Raise 7
On Error Resume Next
out = "after " & Err.Number

cases.name: on_error_goto_0

Err.Raise 7
On Error GoTo 0
out = "after " & Err.Number

cases.name: on_error_goto_label
cases.body:
On Error Resume Next
Err.Raise 7
On Error GoTo Bad
out = "after " & Err.Number
GoTo Done
Bad:
out = "bad"
Done:

cases.name: handler_exit
cases.body: out = HandlerExit() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: caller_error_through_builtin
cases.body:
On Error Resume Next
Err.Raise 7
Dim n As Long
n = Len("abc")
out = "after " & Err.Number

s = Application.Name

cases.name: caller_error_through_sub

Err.Raise 7
PlainSub
out = "after " & Err.Number

cases.name: set_then_call
cases.body:
Err.Number = 5
out = "before " & Err.Number & " / " & Plain() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: nested_calls
cases.body:
On Error Resume Next
Err.Raise 7
out = Outer() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: handler_label
cases.body: out = HandlerLabel() & " / after " & Err.Number

cases.name: handler_resume

cases.name: error_statement

cases.name: resume_next_keeps

On Error Resume Next
Err.Raise 7
Dim x As Long
x = 1
out = "after " & Err.Number

Err.Raise 7
